ptr.note: The destination frame, borrowed for the call; C requires it clean (av_assert1 on its size and layout only): scalars, metadata, side data and buf[] are overwritten or appended without release, so a frame holding anything leaks. On failure C av_frame_unref's it. For a refcounted source it gains new references to every buf/extended_buf/hw_frames_ctx/opaque_ref (unchecked 32-bit AVBuffer counts) and private_ref, copies of metadata, side data entries (sharing buffers, force_copy=0) and channel layout, a memdup of a separate extended_data (nb_channels entries), and src's data/linesize. For a non-refcounted source (buf[0] NULL) it av_frame_get_buffer's (UNINITIALISED bytes outside the copied lines) and av_frame_copy's src's planes through src's geometry. Rust: FrameMut::try_clone_from resets it first, refuses counts near u32::MAX/2 and uncounted planar audio reading past extended_data, and swaps uncounted copies for zeroed buffers. The non-refcounted path's av_frame_get_buffer(dst, 0) overflows int for audio of INT_MAX - 31 samples (av_samples_get_buffer_size's FFALIGN rounding); Rust refuses that copy (EINVAL), as it does for FrameMut::assign's copy path.

The source frame, read only: properties, side data, metadata and references are shared or copied into dst; its planes are read only when buf[0] is NULL (av_frame_copy, one extended_data entry per planar channel unchecked).
